title: Rocco’s Black Friday Sale: Smart Fridges Hit Their Lowest Prices of 2026
summary: The new Essential and certain colors of the original Classic are at their lowest prices of the year.
llm_summary: Rocco’s Black Friday sale is offering the steepest discounts of the year on its smart refrigerators, with the new Essential line and select color variants of the original Classic model hitting their lowest 2026 prices yet. Shoppers can expect significant savings on these connected kitchen appliances, making it an ideal time to upgrade to a Wi‑enabled fridge. This deal underscores the growing popularity and affordability of smart home appliances.
